Like many hunters of Yharnam, the Chorus Hunter wears light weight leather armor to allow for great mobility, offsetting this with his heavy duty weaponry. Having armed himself with a spear that doubles as a fire arm, as well as explosives. The Choruss have a saying; "if a weapon ain't got kick, it just ain't worth it."

The Choruss were some of the best at cleansing the beasts from the streets of Yharnam, their speed and heavy weaponry unmatched by other hunters as they left nothing but charred blood and ashes in their wake each night of the hunt.

The nights of the hunt can be long, and the Choruss have become skilled in not just slaying beasts, but also tuning their equipment or preparing themselves for next target. A powderkeg can always tune equipment, find the best places to hide from ambushes, and even tend to their wounds when it's time to recuperate.
Will the hunt finally be over for me?
The scent of blood draws beasts.
Let me dress that for you.
It's no Old Blood, but it will do.
These beasts are simple, lowly creatures.
We will best this scourge that plagues our people.
The light of our toches keeps us safe.
We will not falter to the whispers of madness.
The Old Blood treats all wounds.
Thank the nuns of the Healing Church.
May the Healing Church guide us.
These incense will keep the beasts at bay.
People of Yharnam burned these during the Hunt.
The smell will repel most beasts.
The light promises safety in the darkest of hunts.
The Hunter will not become the hunted.
I will not stop until every beast is slain.
Here, allow me to give that some kick.
I can modify that for you.
Best not to fight these creatures head on.
You'll plague this world no longer!
These beasts don't deserve Djura's mercy.
Another step to ending this hunt.
A man wielding a firearm like none had ever seen had stumbled into the town recently. He kept muttering something about escaping "the dream.
Late survivors of a deceased covenant, the arsenal they bring may be enough firepower to level our adversaries."
As monstrous threats stalk hamlet during the darkest of nights, the Choruss begin cleansing the beasts that run rampant in our town.
These beasts will fall before me!
I've slain more powerful beasts than you!
Drive them back from whence they came!
These foul beasts are nothing before us!
I will not join your doom!
WE'LL ALL BE BEASTS SOONER OR LATER!
Beasts... Beasts all over the shop!
The smell of the hunt... Blood!
You're infected aren't you? Get away from me!
The smell of the hunt. It drives me mad!
I can't see straight! All I see is red!
They're mine to kill! Blood! Mine!
Don't tell me what to do!
You think that'll put me down!?
You'll be one of them soon!
You're one of them aren't you!
No... I don't want to go back to the dream...
Why are we resting? The hunt isn't over!
